subject: ddl: use job args to pass runtime info for truncate/drop/recover table/partition (#56632)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to DDL/meta schema-diff/placement bundle effects for drop/truncate/recover table/partition. Change replaces `job.CtxVars` with typed `jobCtx.jobArgs` (+ a few runtime-only arg fields) so `SchemaDiff.AffectedOpts` is built from the same decoded args instance that the job step populates, and avoids redundant decoding (incl. making `DropTableArgs.decodeV1` a no-op for non-`ActionDropTable` so drop view/sequence paths can share the helper safely). Traced each affected job handler to confirm it sets `jobCtx.jobArgs` and populates the runtime fields immediately before `updateSchemaVersion` is called; checked later `upstream/master` history for these files and saw follow-up refactors but no fix indicating a Blocker/High regression from this change.
